name: GLM 5.3 FlashX Legal
short: Z.ai's legal-domain adaptation of GLM 5.3 FlashX (1M context) combining hybrid sparse/linear attention with domain post-training for contract analysis and compliance.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
pricingTiers: Z.ai direct $0.37 in / $1.25 out per 1M, $0.075 cached read (limited-time; ZenMux labels all three limited-time)
AgentSky resell $0.429385 in / $1.450625 out, $0.087038 cache read
standout: Native 1M context with domain-specialized legal reasoning and high-throughput streaming for document review; the only measured data is Benchable's category aggregate (coding 95.0% at the 85th percentile, complex multi-step reasoning 96.0% at the 75th).
tradeoff: Specialized legal mid-training gives narrower general utility than general-domain FlashX variants, and the vendor's own docs still contradict each other on image input (change log claims native multimodality, the Retrieve Model reference returns input_modalities ["text"]), so treat the folder's vision scores as unverified. Legal-domain routing: this model lives under models_legal/, not model/, which pnpm sync does not score - the average below is frozen pending the mirror-tree wiring (audit item E2).
